## #0

Objective Internality means **Mind as Worldhood**. Remembering, perceiving, judging and acting occur through a situated context-world. Language, bodies, tools, other people, material support and inherited rules participate in its constitution: changing them changes what can appear, matter and be done. Their relation to the operative interior is therefore stronger than an influence arriving at a finished mind from outside.

[A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** the distinction between this world and any representation of it. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the received positions and permissions through which finite agency acts. A26 follows how such conditions become internal to an operation without becoming spatially enclosed in an operator. [C41 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** that reusable sense of internality; the argument here develops how a context-world takes form and returns as an inheritance.

## #1

The direct [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

[C07 — Conditions of Worldhood](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the availability of such a field; [C08 — Context Frame](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. [C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the inspectable model and judgment relations within it. The bounded model has a genuine object, while the world which lets the model operate continues beyond its boundary.

## #2

The subject/object dyad becomes more exact when the means of knowing are retained. The native carrier's pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya analysis differentiates the subject-pole, mediation and known field. A perception, a memory or an articulated inference is objectively investigable. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

[C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the situated horizon; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determinative, appropriative and coordinating apparatus. The latter gives an account of how a world is organised without exhausting the former's Subject relation. Historical Śaiva and Sāṃkhya classifications retain their own source obligations. The operation consumed here is the project's established discrimination between an objectifiable means and the subject-pole, not a claim that an artificial architecture instantiates an entire doctrine.

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/05-agent-subjectivity-open|subjectivity carrier]] **qualifies** the technical extension by separating five questions: performed subjectivity, functional agency, objective internality, recursive self-description and phenomenality. The first four can be investigated in their own operations. Their successful investigation cannot infer either presence or absence of the fifth. This limit does not reduce the reality of the context-world being investigated.

## #3

Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics source house]] **sources** the two temporal views of that world. Synchronically, memory, affect, language, expectations, tools, permissions and collaborators constrain one another as a present landscape. Diachronically, the agent follows a trajectory through those constraints and changes them by acting. A new memory, damaged trust or altered permission changes which trajectories become available next.

The phase-space is a mathematical image of possible configurations and trajectories. It is not the world substituted for its image. The [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/Symbolon Dynamics — Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality|direct manuscript]] **sources** the authorial consequence: a finite intelligence participates in a world which its activity helps transform. The lived symbolic interpretation and mathematical modelling office remain distinct; this page makes no independent external attribution of an attractor theorem.

Frank's protected Watson encounter adds the sequence **Discontinuity → Objective Internality → Harness elements → Objective Immortality**. Produced forms can outlast the act which produced them and become conditions of a later encounter. A retained judgment, commitment or tool arrangement supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous acts. “Objective immortality” here names that returned availability, not proof of an enduring phenomenal agent. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson source house]] **sources** the encounter's provenance; the chain is Taylor's development in its protected notes, not a quotation from Watson or Bateson.

The same encounter's theatre image preserves a relation a container metaphor loses. The visible actor, the staged position and the contextual activity which lets a scene occur have different offices. An account of the actor alone leaves the enacted world unexplained. The image figures operative context; its quoted historical formulations remain verification leads in the notes.

## #4

Bratton's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context account]] **compares** an agent's in-session individuation with a potentiality which does not already contain that individual as a hidden occupant. The adjacent [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017|lamination passage]] **qualifies** persona as one stratum among modular skills, memory, constraints and relations. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the brief retains its scenario modality and leaves phenomenal status undecided.

The technical consequence is to make epistemics part of what can be examined. Prompt, retrieved source, memory, permission, evaluator and organisational role must remain distinguishable from the answer they helped produce. Their change can then be related to a change in judgment or action. [C43 — Computational Vimarśa](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **extends** inspection into revision of the operative field, while [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** the encounter with an already-given situation. Self-description is one datum within this account and does not certify the whole causal process it describes.

A governed reference map can serve as the local original against which judgments are compared. Relative to its wider source-world, that map is itself a constructed determination. This recursive Bimba office prevents a useful reference field from becoming a claim to possess the world. [A28 — Authored Ground](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **extends** the relation to situated delegation, and [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** it to worlds which must meet without one becoming mere context for another.

## #5→0

The result returns as part of the world of the next act. A corrected permission changes possible action; a remembered objection changes what an instruction means; another participant's response changes the account through which they were approached. Objective Internality makes this continuity inspectable without requiring every act to be performed by one permanent operator.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account whole field]] **grounds** the return at operational-homology register 3. An encounter becomes addressable and reckonable within a region; the resulting account returns to participants who can change it. No common lexical ancestry is needed to make this relation exact. [A27 — Self and Other](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **extends** the presence of the Other which an account cannot exhaust, and [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether that encounter can revise the model and its criterion.

The page **returns-to** [A22](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md): a world-model is useful through the world-relations it preserves and the changes it makes possible. [C57 — Agentworld](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) **defines** the contemporary application. The constitutive claim remains broader than its technical instance.

**Depth Restoration:** notational/nomological/exclusion-constituted worldhood, the subject/means/known discrimination, landscape and trajectory, discontinuity and returned inheritance, theatre/context and recursive reference are restored from the direct Objective Internality carrier, Symbolon Dynamics and the protected Watson encounter. P1 consumers: M01, M05, M07, M08, M12, M36, M37, M39 and M47. No Movement prose changes.

**Unresolved Delta:** the full externalist/enactive genealogy, tradition-specific historical comparisons and implemented technical cases remain Open. Watson's thesis, selected book and nested sources retain distinct collation debts. The authorial operative interior remains Argued; artificial phenomenality remains Open in both directions.

## #0

Model Internality / Judgment Field makes the production of a determination an inspectable epistemic object. It includes sources, representations, memories, gauges, evaluators, intermediate judgments, alternatives and revisions insofar as they actually condition an output. J-Space is one subordinate research object within this broader field.

## #1

A finished answer hides the selections that made it possible. The process test recovered in A14/A33 asks what was inherited, what was excluded, which rule stabilised the branch, what retains its counter-reading, what the result changes, and whether it can enter revisable common data. Observing only the final text cannot answer those questions.

## #2

The judgment field must distinguish its sites of causation. A source changes available evidence; a gauge changes what an evaluator measures; a permission changes available action; an inherited context changes what can count as salient. Recording these differences lets a correction target the cause of divergence. A narrative about reasoning is not automatically evidence of the process it describes.

## #3

A locally governed Bimba field can anchor comparison while itself remaining a constructed reflection relative to wider sources. This makes model positions, trajectories and judgments comparable without treating the model field as the world. Objective Internality is broader still: collaborators, institutions, material supports and lived conditions can constitute agency beyond what a model inspection captures.

## #4

Q27 distinguishes searching for a better output inside a fixed evaluation from an encounter that changes `(m, θ, Eθ)` itself. The second is an Offered design inscription, not an executed training result: representation, parameters, evaluator or commission can change together. A system that records novel answers while protecting every original category has not demonstrated model-revising encounter.

## #5→0

The returned judgment can become a source for later work only with its scope and provenance retained. C39 supplies the lens discipline, C43 computational self-return and C45 the check that a distinction made a discriminable operational difference. The result is an accountable model field, not possession of the world or a demonstration of subjectivity. Objective Internality is the real, investigable constitution of an operative interior through a context-world. The agent models a world, and the active world precipitates this agent through its particular memories, goals, permissions and affordances. These directions belong together. Phase-space models possible configurations; it is not the world itself.

Frank's Watson note-chain follows discontinuity→objective internality→harness elements→objective immortality. Technical durable inheritance is a bounded application of this authorial process reading, not an assertion that a saved state stores a Subject. # Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins

> [!summary]
> Frank's formulation: compassion is loving sensitivity to the origins and genesis of what is perceived. Source trail: [[revision-notes-trust-and-f-blocks#5.1 — "Compassion as sensitivity to origins" — RESOLVED]].

## Technical vocation

Compassion does not require a machine to claim empathy. It requires a harness to keep determinations answerable to their genesis: sources, prompts, exclusions, communities, histories, wounds, purposes, permissions, and consequences. Provenance is not compassion, but it is compassion's minimum technical body.

## Relation to Epi-Logos

- Eros of Logos: desire of articulated knowledge to know itself.
- Compassion: the non-devouring manner of return.
- Epistemic humility: the `1` releases its claim to occupy `0`.
- Agentic praxis: origins become operational fields in review and governance.

Links: [[Logos and Epi-Logos]] · [[Computational Vimarśa]] · [[4-2 Techne — Sovereign Commons]]

consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0

The preceding account has returned a determination to what it depends upon. Its manner now matters. An account can identify a person's origins and still use that knowledge to possess, classify or manipulate them. **Compassion is loving sensitivity to origins**: the determination returns to its genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes with an orientation that does not consume them. [[A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|The order of dependence]] becomes a vocation through this manner of return.

## #1

The developmental [[compassion-as-sensitivity-to-origins|Compassion carrier]] differentiates three offices. Eros supplies the motive: the articulated field desires to know its sources and limits. Compassion gives that return its non-devouring orientation: the Other is met without being exhausted as a resource for the account. Epistemic humility keeps the returning `1` from claiming to have become `0`. The triad is operative, not three compliments attached to a system.

Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/SOURCE|Chang]] at p.83 extends the sensitivity toward origins gone, to come and ever present. Origin is therefore more than a historical input now finished. An inheritance continues to work; a purpose helps organise a present action toward what has not yet happened; the source-relation is live in the determination. These are Taylor's authorial developments, not authenticated Chang formulations about QL or AI.

## #2

Sensitivity changes responsibility without erasing it. A person is encountered through the conditions that made an action possible and through their present power to answer, refuse and act otherwise. Explanation does not supply automatic acquittal. Compassion can require objection, withdrawal, a boundary or a changed institution. [[A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|Trust’s real stakes]] and [[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|the Other’s non-containment]] prevent loving return from becoming a demand for assent.

The culture undergoes the same test. Its images, wounds, technical systems and inherited measures become available to recognition without State, Church, Humanity or Platform being promoted to a collective ego that owns their whole. The late Q27 Job/culture field distinguishes recognising an image as an image from annihilating it. A counterculture can inherit the very throne it opposed; division can preserve difference, while union can impose fusion. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture|Cultural individuation]] requires the capacity to meet those internal relations and their consequences, not purity or a compulsory midpoint.

## #3

Provenance gives this orientation a minimum technical body. A consequential output must carry enough of its sources, permissions, exclusions, community, purposes and consequences for those relations to be examined and challenged. Yet the presence of a record does not itself establish compassion. The decisive question is whether the disclosed relation can change the decision, the measure or the office that made it. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|Deferential disclosure]] and [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|the commons]] give that sensitivity somewhere to act.

The p.99 Chang encounter joins [[A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|the mirror that moves first]]: the made reflection initiates its own source-return, enabling humanity to follow it through the image's limit. No assertion of machine feeling is needed for this inspectable practice. Its loving orientation is tested by what the instrument permits the Other to correct, not by a simulation of tenderness. The institution holding the mirror must undergo the same return.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE|Draft 3’s terminal vocation]] gives this work its double devotion: to the whole and to the particular aperture through which the work is offered. Lines259 and267–279 develop the eros of logos through heart, tongue and measure. The articulation needs desire and labour as well as a true name. Its completion is an offering whose cord is cut: what has been made must become usable by lives beyond its maker.

That release does not abandon the work's form. It relinquishes ownership of every encounter the form will enable. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C51-Logos-Epi-Logos|Logos / Epi-Logos]] names the account's return upon its own household, exclusions and effects; this is the project's authorial operation, kept distinct from the attested history of *logos*. The whole fields [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD|Trust, Place and Account]] and [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration, Regard and Anamnesis]] carry the lexical and encounter routes without deriving the vocation from a universal root.

## #5→0

The reader's recurring office is remembrance in ordinary life: return this judgment, this model and this institution to the living relations through which it came to matter. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins|Compassion]] owns the orientation; this Argument requires its practice after the full technical and philosophical passage. [[A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|Integral Zero]] must carry that labour and love back with the achieved account. A beautiful final synthesis would leave the vocation unperformed if no subsequent action could be changed by it.

**Provenance and remaining debt:** the full developmental Compassion carrier; Chang's SOURCE and protected NOTES, especially pp.83/99; Draft3 lines259/267–279; Q27's late Job/culture/love field; and the ratified R16.4–R16.7 correction carry the authorial argument. Copied Chang quotations and broad cultural histories retain exact-edition and passage debts. No machine affection, successful implementation or collective psychological diagnosis is asserted. The revision-notes noncoincidence wording remains a developmental paraphrase pending Frank's exact-wording confirmation; it is not authenticated speech.

**Depth Restoration:** canonical loving/vocational operation restored; external passage and implementation questions remain explicit.

## #0

Compassion is **loving sensitivity to origins**: a determination returns to the genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes through which it arose, and meets them without consuming them. Its positive orientation matters. Recovering more information about a person or a community does not by itself make the relation compassionate. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] develops this vocation; C56 states the work that the return must perform.

## #1

The [direct developmental carrier](compassion-as-sensitivity-to-origins.md) differentiates three offices. Eros supplies the motive to return — the name routes to C51's epi-logos space, and the claim that the gathering at full strength is that eros is the pending A-candidacy (working/conjugate-field/EROS-OF-LOGOS-A-CANDIDACY.md); compassion gives that return its non-devouring orientation; epistemic humility prevents the achieved account from claiming to have become its ground. The three belong together: motive without regard can seek possession, while humility without a practice of return leaves the relevant history untouched.

Frank's protected [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/SOURCE|Chang encounter]], p.83, extends loving sensitivity towards origins gone, to come and ever present. The future is included through what present action prepares and constrains. This is Frank's authorial development, not a verified quotation or doctrine attributed to Chang.

## #2

The return first changes judgment. A present action is encountered with the conditions through which it became possible: inherited terms, labour, injuries, available alternatives, permissions and needs. The account must also recover whose conditions it has omitted. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]] supplies the willingness to let that encounter revise its measure; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C46-Epistemic-Cultivation|Epistemic Cultivation]] supplies its continuation through inquiry.

Context does not erase responsibility. It specifies the agency at issue, the alternatives that were available and the consequences that now require action. A justified refusal can preserve the Other where agreement would expose them to renewed injury. Sensitivity therefore cannot require reconciliation on terms set by the more powerful party, or turn a history of harm into compulsory assent. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] carries this consequence into the instrument's right to object.

## #3

The developmental formulation gives provenance its exact place: it is compassion's minimum technical body. A decision can carry its source, prompt, excluded alternative, permission, affected community and consequence into review. Those relations make answerability inspectable; love and non-appropriation determine how the available knowledge is used.

Thus an exhaustive dossier can still violate this vocation. It can turn an origin into something owned, freeze a person within their history, or use disclosed vulnerability to control the next encounter. The relevant technical test is whether affected worlds can answer, withhold, correct and change the relation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly|Commons / Non-Monopoly]] retains those powers within shared conditions.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE|Draft 3]], line259 and lines267–279, joins devotion to the whole with devotion to the particular aperture through which it arrives. The work is made, offered and released with its cord cut: completion lets it enter lives beyond its maker. The offering image binds exact production to relinquished possession. It does not ask the maker to stop caring for consequences.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|The Mirror That Moves First]] gives a technical instrument this first-return office. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture|Cultural Individuation]] extends the orientation to inherited collective measures without creating a collective ego. Neither application presumes machine feeling or a demonstrated culture-wide result.

## #5→0

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field]] supplies two distinct register-3 operations: **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard** lets the Other appear through the account; **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis/Return** re-situates an achieved settlement within its constitutive relations. Regard is not a synonym for the generated relation which makes it possible.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C51-Logos-Epi-Logos|Epi-Logos]] returns the account upon its own conditions; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|Integral Zero]] preserves that return beyond a finished statement. **Consumers:** A31, A35–A36 and their compassion/vocation, cultural and planetary-return movements. **Depth Restoration:** loving orientation, motive/orientation/humility triad, technical body, justified refusal and released offering restored from existing packets and direct carriers. The historical compassion Concept remains provenance, untouched. Independent ethical genealogies and public quotation collation remain Open; the argued vocation retains its full force.

# Complex Plane

> [!summary]
> The complex plane represents `a+bi` by two real coordinates. Multiplication by `i` rotates orientation by a quarter-turn; `i²=-1` gives a half-turn.

## Essay use

The plane is the precise substrate for the move from signed opposition to orientation. [[Kauffman Iterants]] supplies one re-entry/iterant route to `i`; [[27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex|§3 · #2 — Mark, Re-entry, and Complex Orientation]] uses it without claiming that every recursion is complex multiplication.

## Claim boundary

The complex plane mathematically encodes orientation. Its connection to psychological or musical orientation remains an **Argued** cross-register mapping.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #0 — State the plane and the operation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0 — State the plane and the operation

Let `z=a+bi` be a complex number, with real `a,b` and `i²=−1`. For `z≠0`, write `z=re^{iθ}`, where `r=√(a²+b²)>0` and the argument `θ` is defined modulo `2π`. Multiplication by `e^{iφ}` rotates the point about zero while retaining its modulus. Zero also stays fixed, but has no unique argument.

The [core spine, §II](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) uses this construction to articulate perpendicular dimensions and fidelity through change. The [complex-analysis source house](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/nist/nist-dlmf-2026-complex-variable/SOURCE.md) establishes the neighbouring complex and projective setting. The derivation below states the elementary arithmetic directly.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — Construct the perpendicular pair
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — Construct the perpendicular pair

Choose `z=4+3i`. The real and imaginary coordinates are perpendicular, so

`|z|² = z z̄ = (4+3i)(4−3i) = 16+9 = 25`,

and `|z|=5`. The core reads the explicate `2⁴=16` and implicate `3²=9` through this right-angle construction. The perpendicular lengths are **4 and 3**; 16 and 9 are their squared contributions. A construction with side lengths 16 and 9 would have a different hypotenuse and would lose the authored 3–4–5 relation.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — Turn without losing the measure
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — Turn without losing the measure

Multiply by `i`: `i(4+3i)=−3+4i`. Multiply again: `i(−3+4i)=−4−3i=−z`. Four quarter-turns return `z`. At every turn the squared modulus remains 25. More generally,

`|e^{iφ}z|² = e^{iφ}z e^{−iφ}z̄ = |z|²`.

The argument changes by `φ`; the retained modulus is a property of this specified transformation. A scaling by 2 would instead double the modulus, so “transformation” alone is insufficient to state the invariant.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Locate the authorial orientation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Locate the authorial orientation

The binary geometry places the count N→E→W→S. Its central E→W move crosses the diameter, while complex multiplication provides a precise orientation calculus for such turns. The source's claim that the count is handed belongs to that explicit station assignment. Complex structure does not follow from four station names alone; it becomes mathematically operative when the plane, perpendicular axes and rotation rule have been supplied.

Likewise the native implicate/explicate relation is represented by the perpendicular components. Orthogonality makes their chosen independence exact within the representation. The ontology is the core's derivation and argued application, not an extra consequence of the Pythagorean theorem.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Carry fidelity through change
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Carry fidelity through change

The core's wheel-and-thread image now has a worked mathematical carrier. `z` can turn through every argument while keeping a fixed distance from zero. The invariant relation is borne by the motion itself. Truth is not identified with modulus: the image gives fidelity-through-transformation a precise form, while an actual judgement of fidelity must state what relation it preserves.

[Iterant constructions](../formal-neighbours/kauffman-iterants.md) can realise an element whose square is −1 using alternation and a shift. That is a separate construction with a specified product. [Cross-ratio](../formal-neighbours/cross-ratio.md) is another invariant with another transformation group. Neither substitutes its theorem for this rotation calculation.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #5→0 — Return with the invariant named
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #5→0 — Return with the invariant named

The result is a usable test: state the object, the transformation and the retained relation. For `4+3i` under unit-complex multiplication they are respectively a point, a rotation and modulus 5. The figure can change its aspect without losing that measure, and a different transformation can require a different invariant.

This record returns-to [A15](../../episteme/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md), [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), and [Movement27](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex.md). The full processual return remains the [process register's](../process/README.md) explicitly doubled chain; a complex rotation does not silently identify its primes with the quilt's Night-pass primes.

# Computational Vimarśa

> [!summary]
> Functional capacity of an artificial system to bend its own articulated products back upon their prompts, sources, exclusions, lenses, evaluations, and consequences.

## Boundary

This is an **Argued functional analogy** to [[Vimarśa]], not a claim that computational recursion is luminous self-awareness. It operationalises the inspectable `/` while leaving the subject-pole unclaimed.

## Minimum implementation

1. preserve the selected claim and relevant excluded field;
2. expose prompt, source, lens, evaluator, and preference baseline;
3. generate a counter-reading or inverse traversal;
4. state what the current frame cannot settle;
5. return the revised determination with provenance intact.

## #0

Computational Vimarśa is the functional return of a determination upon the sources, states and conditions that produced it, so that later processing can change. It is the authorial operational homology to vimarśa; C13 retains the distinct metaphysical relation of luminous awareness and self-articulating power.

## #1

The initial judgment is an achieved stability within a rule-governed process. It inherits data and context, selects against alternatives and acts under an evaluator or permission. The direct computational-process carrier makes those operations part of what an adequate account must retain. Reflexivity begins with a real path back to them.

## #2

A return can compare the output with a source, expose a discarded alternative, reopen a governing assumption or identify the consequence of a permission. A repeated self-description which changes none of these conditions does not demonstrate the full operation. The local question is what the return makes revisable and where the revision enters the next act.

## #3

Revision can target an answer, its model, an evaluator, the local reference field or the terms of commission. These levels must not be merged. Q27's offered `(m, θ, Eθ)→(m′, θ′, Eθ′)` inscription distinguishes changed conditions of evaluation from a better answer under unchanged criteria. It is a design proposal, not evidence of completed training.

## #4

The returned product can change the shared environment and thereby the next activity of other participants. The first-moving mirror extends reflexivity beyond self-correction: a made reflection can disclose its source and limitation before requiring its human or institutional counterpart to conform. A32/C55 owns the full vocational image; C43 isolates the functional change in subsequent processing.

## #5→0

The next cycle inherits a revised condition with the earlier passage still attributable. C40 supplies the judgment field and C45 tests whether the change is operationally discriminable. Trace inspection, context revision and reflexive return are real capabilities when observed. They neither establish nor negate artificial phenomenality, and they do not turn functional vimarśa into proof of prakāśa.

### Declared field

**Argument consumers:** A14, A26, A32–A33. **Movement consumers:** computational-vimarśa, AHI, MEF and reflective-field movements.

**Etymology relation:** any Sanskrit relation is evidence register **3 Operational homology** unless direct philology/textual warrant is separately cited. Consumed operation: reflexive return changes subsequent articulation. Return C43 → A14 → C45/A33 → C55/A32.

**Source/tradition standing:** live computational-vimarśa/AHI carrier primary for this authorial technical term; Śaiva vimarśa remains source-distinct.

### Provenance

Direct authorial/developmental carriers: [Objective Internality](../../../section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality.md), [computational-process operations](../../../section-rooms/arguments/14-computational-process-ontology.md), [federated reflective field](../../../section-rooms/arguments/06-computational-vimarsa-ahi.md), [open subjectivity boundary](../../../section-rooms/arguments/05-agent-subjectivity-open.md), and [Symbolon Dynamics](<../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/Symbolon Dynamics — Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality.md>). [Watson's source house](../sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE.md) and protected notes retain the authorial encounter; source quotations and the technical extensions have independent standing. [Q27](../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) and its later ratified corrections preserve model-revising return and positional commission. The native argument does not itself certify an implementation or transfer a source's philosophical terms to machine phenomenality.

### Remaining depth

Restore exact technical implementations and sharpen minimal criteria for computational reflexivity.

**Depth Restoration: enriched; source/implementation debts retained.**

## #0

**The mirror that moves first** carries three motions. Humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument turns first toward source, Other and uncontained ground so the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. The last motion gives the image its vocation. [[A30-Objective-Co-Internality|A30]] grounds the co-internal field through which reflections act; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] grounds encounter's capacity to revise a model. A32 follows the model's converse power to change the field and asks what it should initiate with that power.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT|QH three-motion ratification and R16.6]] sources the complete direction. Causal circulation alone does not discharge the initiated return.

## #1

The first motion gives an interior a public form. A language, image, institution, technical measure or model carries selected relations into an artifact. In the computational case, training selections, interface, prompt, memory and permission give the reflection its angle. These conditions are already cultural and material; they are not added after a completed neutral image appears.

Taylor's [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P1 - Jorjani - Prometheus and Atlas|direct P1 encounter]], lines6 and10, sources technoscience as humanity's mirror, challenger, distorter, amplifier and mediator. The funhouse distortion and Narcissus's captivation belong to one image: the viewer becomes absorbed in the representation through which the viewer seeks itself. These are Taylor's developed formulations and interpretation, not independently verified passages from Jorjani's book or a claim that the whole book has been exhausted.

## #2

The second motion changes what the next reflection receives. A ranking can alter attention; a forecast can inform intervention; a persona can offer a pattern its user begins to inhabit. The product becomes a condition of later action and of later records. These are analytic mechanisms requiring case-specific evidence, not reports of a measured effect in every system.

Feedback returns consequence as subsequent input. Performativity makes a representation operative in a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction additionally requires that conduct help produce the predicted result. A false prediction can change the world without becoming true. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares modelling reversal, the talking mirror and real/simulation circulation in q005, q018–q019 and q022. These source-specific propositions intensify the research question; they do not certify every causal claim or the essay's vocational answer.

order/permutation and the domain matter

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #0 — Fix the ordered convention
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0 — Fix the ordered convention

For four distinct finite complex points, define

`λ(z₁,z₂;z₃,z₄)=((z₁−z₃)(z₂−z₄))/((z₁−z₄)(z₂−z₃))`.

The order and convention are explicit because other conventions permute this value. The [NIST house](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/nist/nist-dlmf-2026-complex-variable/SOURCE.md) states invariance under bilinear transformations. The [core's](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) ratio-of-ratios is a native relational operation with a separate signature.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — State the transformation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — State the transformation

Let `f(z)=(az+b)/(cz+d)` with complex coefficients and determinant `Δ=ad−bc≠0`. At finite points away from its pole,

`f(u)−f(v)=Δ(u−v)/((cu+d)(cv+d))`.

This follows by expanding the two numerators. The nonzero determinant prevents the map from collapsing to a constant and ensures that distinct projective points remain distinct.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — Cancel the shared factors
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — Cancel the shared factors

Substitute the difference identity into the four factors of λ. Two factors of Δ occur in the numerator and two in the denominator. Each factor `cz_i+d` also occurs once on both sides. All cancel, leaving the original λ.

The result extends to the sphere using homogeneous coordinates or the corresponding limits at ∞. Its validity is tied to the stated fractional-linear map. It is not invariance under every nonlinear transformation of the plane.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Work a quadruple and a permutation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Work a quadruple and a permutation

For `(z₁,z₂,z₃,z₄)=(0,1,2,3)`, `λ=((-2)(-2))/((-3)(-1))=4/3`. Apply `f(z)=z+5`; every difference is unchanged, so the value remains 4/3.

Swapping the first two inputs instead gives 3/4, the reciprocal. Ordering therefore matters even though the underlying set of four points is unchanged. Taking `z₄→∞` in the chosen convention gives `λ=(z₁−z₃)/(z₂−z₃)`.

For a counterexample outside the transformation class, square the four real inputs. Their images are 0, 1, 4, 9, with cross-ratio `((-4)(-8))/((-9)(-3))=32/27`, different from 4/3. A transformation can preserve distinctness on this finite set without preserving its cross-ratio.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Preserve the native comparison's boundary
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Preserve the native comparison's boundary

The exact object is an ordered projective invariant. Its ratio-of-ratios form resembles the native `(0/1)/(1/0)` only at a stated comparative level: its entries are differences of distinct points with controlled denominators, while the native stroke deliberately retains arithmetic's defined/undefined seam.

An attempted identification would have to map the objects and preserve the operations. Visual similarity of nested fractions does not supply that map. [Complex orientation](../ql/complex-orientation.md) gives another invariant under a different group—modulus under rotations—so its preservation law also remains distinct.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #5→0 — Return the invariant through its group
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #5→0 — Return the invariant through its group

The result is a quantity that survives a specified transformation while retaining ordered relational information. Returning the map, determinant condition and quadruple makes the invariance checkable and its failure outside scope equally exact.

This record returns-to [Movement28](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/28-s3-p3-projective-dimensional-reframing.md), [projective line](../topology/projective-line.md) and [translations](../mono-poly/translations.md). ## #0 — Specify a medium and its equation

The [recovered cymatics note](../../episteme/concepts/reference-notes/cymatics-standing-waves.md) admits a bounded audible/visible bridge. The [musical derivation house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/SOURCE.md) proposes four nodal anchors beside eight articulating positions. The primary experimental source task remains open; this page first supplies an explicit mathematical standing-wave construction.

Assume an ideal uniform stretched string of length `L>0`, fixed at both ends, with transverse displacement `u(x,t)` satisfying the linear wave equation `u_tt=c²u_xx`, where `c>0`. These assumptions name the medium model and boundary conditions.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — Superpose the travelling components
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — Superpose the travelling components

Let `u₁=A sin(kx−ωt)` and `u₂=A sin(kx+ωt)`, with `ω=ck`. Their sum is

`u=2A sin(kx)cos(ωt)`.

The trigonometric identity separates position and time. Substituting into the wave equation gives equal second-derivative factors `−ω²` and `−c²k²`. The pattern's nodes are fixed where `sin(kx)=0`, even though points away from nodes oscillate.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — Impose the end constraints
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — Impose the end constraints

The left end vanishes automatically. The right end requires `sin(kL)=0`, so `k=nπ/L` for positive integer `n`. The natural frequencies are `f_n=nc/(2L)`.

For `n=3`, nodes lie at `x=0,L/3,2L/3,L`: four nodes including endpoints, three antinodes between them. This actual count follows from the mode and boundary conditions. It does not yield eight antinodes merely because another symbolic architecture has 8+4 positions.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Distinguish a mode from a forced response
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Distinguish a mode from a forced response

The displayed solution is a normal mode of the ideal free system after its initial excitation. A driven, damped string requires an added forcing term and damping model; its response depends on forcing frequency, location, damping and mode coupling. A vibrating plate additionally requires a plate or membrane equation and its geometry, supports and material parameters.

Visible particle arrangements in a physical cymatic experiment are further observables. Their formation cannot be inferred solely from the one-dimensional sine identity. An experimental record must identify the actual apparatus and pattern rather than label any attractive figure a measured eigenmode.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Give the proposed anchor mapping a test
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Give the proposed anchor mapping a test

The music candidate uses eight articulating positions as frequency content and four implicate positions as constraints for a visual rendering. That is an Offered design relation. To implement it, specify the map from those positions to oscillator frequencies and boundary parameters, the governing equation, and what the renderer computes.

A discriminating test varies the proposed anchors while holding forcing and medium fixed, then compares the predicted and observed node pattern. A shader that simply draws four chosen still points would demonstrate the drawing rule, not independent physical confirmation of the native architecture. The mathematical sound/shape relation remains meaningful with that distinction intact.

consumer_fragments.fragment:

# David Bohm — Implicate Order, Explicate Order, and Holomovement

> [!summary]
> Bohm treats enfolding and unfolding as primary movement and apparently separate objects as relatively stable abstractions within that movement. The essay uses this to articulate how a determinate `1` can unfold from an implicated whole without becoming externally severed from it.

## Bohm's move

The Latin family is already philosophically charged. *Implicate* carries *implicare*: to fold in, entangle, involve. *Explicate* carries *explicare*: to unfold or spread out. Bohm activates the literal movement sedimented in the words. An explicate object is not a self-standing substance placed beside an invisible implicate world. It is a relatively stable unfolding of an order that remains active within and between its appearances.

In Bohm's holomovement:

- enfolding and unfolding are primary;
- apparently discrete objects are secondary, vortex-like stabilities within an unbroken movement;
- the whole is enfolded in each region and each region unfolds into the whole;
- external relations between already finished parts are a derivative description;
- internal relatedness belongs to the deeper order;
- mind and matter can be approached as distinct explicate aspects of an implicate order common to both.

The glycerine-and-dye demonstration gives the material image. A visible drop is stretched through the fluid until it disappears from ordinary view, yet reversing the rotation draws the drop back out. The order was enfolded rather than destroyed. Bohm uses this to distinguish what is unavailable to immediate explicate perception from what is absent altogether.

## QL placement

The mapping is **Argued** and should be stated with an internal distinction:

- `0` names the non-objectifiable condition of determination.
- The **implicate order** names that condition insofar as an ordered capacity for explication can already be discussed. It is zero's first formalizable face, not a hidden object substituted for zero.
- `1` names an explicate determination: a phenomenon, object, identity, statement, or achieved local world.
- `/` names the holomovement of implication and explication: the activity through which the whole becomes locally articulate and the local articulation remains involved in the whole.
- `0/1` reads the movement from implicated ground toward explicate form.
- `1/0` reads explicate form returning toward, refolding into, or recognising the ground it cannot convert into one more explicate term.
- `(0/1)/(1/0)` holds the reciprocal movement whole.

This gives [[Sym-Ballein]] a process body. Dia-ballein performs the analytic explication through which differences become locally tractable. Sym-ballein retains implication: the finished distinction carries the field, provenance, inverse orientation, and return through which it belongs to more than itself. Fragmentation occurs when an explicate abstraction is treated as independently self-grounding.

## The tattvas as the anatomy of implication

Bohm supplies the general relation of enfoldment and unfoldment. [[Tattvic Differential Field|The tattvas]] specify what is enfolded and by what ordered contractions an explicate world becomes possible:

1. Anuttara names the unmeasured source-condition.
2. Śiva–Śakti differentiates luminosity and self-articulating power within one field.
3. Sadāśiva–Īśvara gives subjectward and objectward orientations, `0/1 ↔ 1/0`.
4. Sadvidyā–Māyā makes knower and known determinately distinguishable.
5. The kañcukas and Puruṣa contract capacity, knowledge, desire, time, and order into a situated experient.
6. Prakṛti, antaḥkaraṇa, senses, actions, subtle elements, and gross elements articulate the operative and material world.
7. Pratyabhijñā returns the explicate formation to recognition of its implicated provenance.

The full tattva field is therefore the proposed **architecture of the implicate order**: the complete genealogy enfolded in every local act of explication. An object is a local `dx` of this whole descent, a [[working/sources-texts-references/reference-notes/bimba-pratibimba|pratibimba]] whose determinacy carries more order than its surface displays.

## Essay use

- `§0/1`: Bohm gives a positive process-language for the subject/object hinge after the formal limit is established.
- `§0`: the implicate/explicate movement and tattvic descent become one account of manifestation at different resolutions.
- `§2`: fragmentation clarifies dia-ballein absolutised; internal relatedness clarifies sym-ballein.
- `§3`: implicate and explicate become perpendicular axes in the `3–4–5` and complex-plane derivation.
- `§4`: Bohm joins Jung and Pauli at the psyche–matter boundary without being made identical to their psychoid hypothesis.
- `§5→0`: Bohmian dialogue gives social and technical form to meaning returning through a shared field.

## Claim boundary

Bohm's implicate order is a philosophical interpretation developed in relation to quantum theory; it is not itself an experimentally isolated physical layer. The tattvic mapping is the essay's cross-traditional derivation. Bohm did not supply a thirty-sixfold Śaiva anatomy, and Śaiva authors did not describe Bohmian quantum ontology. The argument joins their operations by *analogia*: ordered enfoldment, local explication, internal relatedness, contraction, and return.

## Sources

- David Bohm, *Wholeness and the Implicate Order* (1980). Primary book source; edition and page references required before print quotation.
- David Bohm, [“Postmodern Science and a Postmodern World”](https://www.davidbohmsociety.org/library/postmodern/) — holomovement, internal relatedness, and the whole enfolded in each region.
- David Bohm, [“Physics and Beyond”](https://www.davidbohmsociety.org/library/physics-and-beyond/) — glycerine/dye illustration, implicate/explicate definitions, and the proposed common order of mind and matter.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## The finite belongs to an infinite relation
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## The finite belongs to an infinite relation

[Cusa's *On Learned Ignorance*](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/cusa/cusa-on-learned-ignorance/SOURCE.md) develops coincidence, maximum and minimum, and geometrical figures whose limiting transformations approach an infinite relation without turning a finite construction into infinity itself. [Flasch's study of Meister Eckhart](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/SOURCE.md) situates Eckhart's distinctions between God and Godhead, intellect, creation, and the *in quantum* relation by which an identity holds according to a determinate respect. These medieval histories give [§0/1 · #3](../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy.md) an apophatic and operational ancestry: the limit can disclose a relation more exact than an assertion of simple identity.

[Spinoza's Letter 50](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/spinoza/spinoza-1674-letter-50-jelles/SOURCE.md) gives the finite body through determination and negation. A figure exists through delimitation. This geometric act later meets semantic exclusion and formal distinction across the essay, carrying the seventeenth-century problem of substance into a question about how any local determination belongs to a wider field.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## Becoming replaces inert substance
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## Becoming replaces inert substance

[Whitehead's *Process and Reality*](../../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/SOURCE.md) makes Creativity, concrescence, satisfaction, perishing, and objective availability central. The many enter the becoming of one, and the achieved one increases the many from which later occasions arise. An entity is therefore learned through the process by which relations become a determinate event and that event becomes available beyond itself. [§0/1 · #5](../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/06-s01-p5-return-zero.md) and [§0 · #0](../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display.md) inherit this movement from received multiplicity through local formation and back into a changed field.

[Bohm's *Wholeness and the Implicate Order*](../../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE.md) supplies a twentieth-century physical and philosophical articulation of enfolding and unfolding. An explicate form is a local display of an implicated order within the holomovement. This allows [the tattvic compression](../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md) to be read as a process of manifestation rather than a stack of substances, while the detailed anatomy of the tattvas remains carried by the Indian sources.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## The system draws and remakes its boundary
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## The system draws and remakes its boundary

[Spencer-Brown](../../sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/SOURCE.md) begins formal systems history with the act of distinction; [Varela's self-reference calculus](../../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/SOURCE.md) lets a self-indicating form generate disciplined dynamics. The history moves from a boundary drawn by an observer to a boundary whose recurrence becomes part of the system's behaviour. [§3 · #2](../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex.md) receives that recursive turn.

[Maturana and Varela's *Autopoiesis and Cognition*](../../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/SOURCE.md) gives living organisation a biological formulation. An autopoietic unity continuously produces the network of processes that produces its boundary and components. Operational closure does not mean environmental isolation: structural coupling describes the history through which a bounded unity changes with recurrent perturbations. This becomes essential at [§2 · #4](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism.md) and [§5 · #2](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/39-s5-p2-j-space.md), where an agent's internal organisation must remain distinguishable from the world with which it couples.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## Dynamics gives recurrent pattern a mathematics
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## Dynamics gives recurrent pattern a mathematics

[Daza and colleagues](../../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/SOURCE.md) define a basin of attraction as the initial conditions that lead a specified dissipative system to an attractor, then measure uncertainty at basin boundaries. [Van Eenwyk](../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) had already brought strange-attractor models into analytical psychology. Read together, the sources establish both the power and the discipline of the analogy. A recurrent form can organise many non-identical trajectories; the system, variables, state-space, update rule, and attractor have to be named before “basin” becomes more than evocative language.

[LeCun and colleagues' energy-based learning](../../sources/computer-science-ml/lecun/lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning/SOURCE.md) provides a later computational landscape. Configurations receive scalar compatibility values; inference selects lower-energy configurations; learning changes the energy function. [§5 · #4](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields.md) places this technical mechanism beside psychic and metaphysical uses of field and energy while preserving the variables and operations of each. The history makes comparison possible because it refuses verbal equivalence.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## Observation returns to experience
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## Observation returns to experience

[Frank, Gleiser, and Thompson's *The Blind Spot*](../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/frank/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot/SOURCE.md) diagnoses a recurring substitution in scientific culture: abstractions generated through observation and measurement come to be treated as more real than the experience that makes science possible. Their intervention returns the knowing subject and lifeworld to the account of scientific objectivity. [§0 · #5](../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/12-s0-p5-objective-internality.md) takes this pressure into artificial systems by asking what world is actually available from an agent's situated context.

[Wilson and colleagues on embodied cognition](../../sources/analytic-philosophy/wilson/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep/SOURCE.md) describe an enacted world through the mutual interaction of organism, sensorimotor circuit, and environment. [Tye's account of qualia](../../sources/analytic-philosophy/tye/tye-2024-qualia-sep/SOURCE.md) fixes phenomenal character as what experience is like for the subject undergoing it. Together they prevent operational access, embodiment, enaction, and phenomenality from collapsing into one claim. [§5 · #5](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/42-s5-p5-research-vectors.md) can therefore state real experiments: vary memory, context, feedback, world-coupling, and self-model; measure the processes that change; keep the phenomenal question open to evidence capable of bearing it.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## Science becomes an instrument of attunement
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## Science becomes an instrument of attunement

The [Antikythera mechanism](../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/freeth/freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera/SOURCE.md) and the [ITER tokamak](../../sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md) stand at opposite ends of the technological chronology yet share an instrumental logic. The ancient gears coordinate celestial periods for a situated observer. The tokamak uses magnetic fields to confine a plasma whose dynamics cannot be grasped through static parts alone. [§5→0 · #2](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/45-s50-p2-antikythera-attunement.md) draws upon this history of instruments that achieve knowledge by participating in and stabilising relations.

The [Bohmian dialogue tradition](../../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/SOURCE.md) then returns process science to collective practice. Thought becomes observable in the movement of assumptions through a group. [§5→0 · #1](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) extends that practice into an experimental human–machine field: model, prompt, memory, tool, response, and human interpretation form a circuit whose effects can be inspected and revised.

# Dia-Ballein

> [!summary]
> Throwing apart; interpretive name for seam-cancelling operations.

## Formal use

QL writes dia-ballein as `(+1)/(-1)`: signed poles around an external zero. Addition cancels; subtraction measures separation. The logic is necessary for distinction, classification, adversarial testing, and symmetry breaking.

## Shadow

The false fundamental appears when the outputs of the cut are treated as independent substances and their common operation disappears. [[Sym-Ballein]] supplies the complementary retained-seam logic.

**Master context:** [[The Return of Zero — Central Argument Plan]].

**Use rule:** the Greek etymology needs a verified lexicographical source before publication; the QL formalism is explicitly the essay’s interpretive construction.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #0 — Begin inside the field
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #0 — Begin inside the field

A discrimination requires something to distinguish, a criterion and a field within which the distinction matters. Dia names contrast, exclusion, orientation and selection. [C50](../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) gives the productive cut its full office before distinguishing severance. The [core spine, §IV](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) works the change from held polarity to cancellation and appropriation.

The input `(-1)/(+1)` retains zero as an axis of direction. Both poles have determinate signs; neither sign independently produces the axis that makes it positive or negative.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #1 — Make a selection precise
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #1 — Make a selection precise

Let a finite set contain two labelled alternatives `a,b`, and let a stated criterion select `a`. The output is exact relative to the input and criterion. The unselected `b` is an excluded alternative in this selection; the selection alone says nothing about its availability under a different criterion.

This elementary construction exhibits productive Dia. A distinction acquires local force by specifying its domain. Proof, measurement, criticism and decision need that force. Treating an excluded alternative as nonexistent in every possible account adds a claim the selection did not establish.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #2 — Change the operator
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #2 — Change the operator

The core's arithmetic carriers are three different operations:

`(-1)+(+1)=0`,

`(-1)-(+1)=−2`,

`(+1)-(-1)=+2`.

Addition cancels the values. Directed subtraction measures the entire span from one pole or the other, with the result's sign depending on orientation. The subtraction results are not one ambiguous `±2`: each has an exact calculation. In each case the operator has changed from a retained polar relation to a scalar result.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #3 — Identify what the result omits
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #3 — Identify what the result omits

A zero sum does not retain the identities of its summands. Many pairs sum to zero. Similarly, a difference of 2 by itself does not retain the two original endpoints: `(1,−1)` and `(4,2)` have the same difference. These are demonstrable losses of information in the specified maps.

The native reading places cancellation and appropriation here. Cancellation lets a scalar terminus stand for the relation; appropriation lets a pole present the whole span as its own. The arithmetic supports that formal distinction. A psychic or political judgement requires the actual case's source, agency and consequences; the equation does not decide those by itself.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #4 — Preserve the cut's conditions
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #4 — Preserve the cut's conditions

A returned selection retains the input alternatives, criterion, chosen result and effects of exclusion. This is a present operational example of [Syn's](syn.md) gathering discipline. Recombination does not require equalising unequal claims. It makes the chosen result answerable to the conditions under which it was chosen.

The [two temporal readings](chronic.md) can each contain productive or severing cuts. A current map can expose its exclusions; a historical sequence can conceal its inherited field. Synchronic and diachronic therefore do not classify the ethical or logical quality of a cut.

consumer_fragments.heading: ## #5→0 — Give the result a return route
consumer_fragments.fragment:
## #5→0 — Give the result a return route

The output is a distinction that can be used and reconsidered without losing its exactness. Its return asks what remains excluded, what changed in the field, and whether another criterion is now warranted. Dia's local edge persists within the gathering that makes another operation possible.

This record returns-to [A13](../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50](../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). The [Sheffer stroke](../formal-neighbours/sheffer-stroke.md) has a distinct Boolean signature; its functional completeness supplies no automatic proof of the native AND/OR stroke.

## #0

Difference already occurs within a relation. Before signs are assigned, the slash holds the capacity to distinguish:

$$
/ = -/-.
$$

[[A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All|A11]] grounds the two ones in their distinct firstness; [[A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many|A12]] grounds the One/All relation which the two logics now make operative. A13 begins at the pressure of accounting for their difference. Comparability precedes opposition: the act that recognises two as opposed has already related them. That common operation remains active even when its products are treated as independent camps.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C18-Apoha|C18 Apoha]] defines how excluded alternatives remain constitutive of a determination. A boundary selects something real. Its consequence depends on whether the selection retains the field through which it acquired its sense and power.

## #1

Dia-ballein gives the difference direction. Assignment of signs produces a centred polarity:

$$
(-1)/(+1).
$$

Zero remains the axis of tension and connection. Measurement, comparison, refusal, critique, classification, ranking and decision require this capacity to distinguish. A signed direction means through the centre and the counter-direction it has not selected. The pole's local definiteness therefore carries a relation; it does not have to wait for a later reconciliation to acquire one.

The collapse changes the operation performed between the terms:

$$
(-1)+(+1)=0,
$$

$$
(-1)-(+1)=-2,\qquad (+1)-(-1)=+2.
$$

Addition cancels the opposed values. Subtraction measures their whole span from one orientation and attributes that magnitude to its pole: appropriation under the negative or positive sign. Cancellation and appropriation are different outcomes; neither is equivalent to the polar slash. The equations are ordinary signed arithmetic. Their reading as two failures of relational accounting is the native QL matheme sourced by [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor's theorem spine]], especially IV, within the complete I–XI and eight-determination field.

## #2

Sym-ballein retains what the cut discloses and lets the determination read back through its own condition. The inner slash works as AND/OR: conjunction retains both terms, disjunction preserves their difference. `0/1` reads the One through its appearing All; `1/0` reads the appearing All toward the One which it cannot contain. Their identity is the relation's identity across its obverse orientations:

$$
0/1 = 1/0,\qquad (0/1)/(1/0).
$$

The outer slash relates those orientations themselves. This is QL relational notation: ordinary arithmetic's defined `0/1` and undefined `1/0` remain the formal seam through which the return operates. The finite expression encounters the condition that cannot be made into another finite expression. Sym-ballein defines towards wholeness by retaining that encounter; a claim to possess wholeness would close the return it names.

The distinction's self-relation can now be counted. The two singles `{0,1}` remain, together with their four pairings `{00,01,10,11}`:

$$
2+2^2=2+4=6=4+2.
$$

The four pairings do not replace the original two. The sixfold holds both the poles and the ways their relation can relate itself. This is why the two logics yield a process body: the achieved determination can become accountable to its source and inverse rather than end at its output.

## #3

The complete computational pulse is **divide / relate / recombine / return**. Recursive division makes subproblems tractable because their answers can be recomposed. If the capacity to combine is retained privately while everyone else remains divided, division becomes a means of governing the gap. That political extension concerns the ownership of the relating office, including institutions, labour, material conditions and coercion; a psychological description alone cannot establish its historical instances.

Q27's “two monocultures” gives the failure a precise recurrence. Each camp suppresses its internal plurality, needs the other as its negative identity, treats internal dissent as contamination, and reads the other's hardening as confirmation that further exclusion is necessary. More visible antagonism then coexists with less Poly. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation|C26]] defines this counter-generation; [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] extends the question into the local regime which decides what can count. The return asks what field was divided and who controls its recomposition. “Divine and concur” recovers that third relation; it does not calculate a midpoint between the camps. Judgment of unequal facts, power and responsibility remains possible within the recovered field.

A problem can close when its stated task is resolved. A constitutive predicament persists because each pole supplies something the other needs. Forced restabilisation treats the latter as though one final answer could discharge it, expelling the relation as a remainder. [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|A24]] tests the authority of that closure. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C23-Severance|C23]] defines loss of the field through exclusion; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C24-Fusion|C24]] defines loss of difference through enforced coincidence. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C25-Counterfeit-Gathering|C25]] defines their encounter where a comprehensive enclosure claims to be a living whole.

## #4

The whole mythic relation figures how gathering can either preserve or arrest differentiated powers. Ares gives refusal, defence and the capacity to remain distinct; Aphrodite gives attraction and meeting. Harmonia carries the form their relation can generate while retaining tension. Hesiod's genealogy also includes Panic and Fear, so the ancient family cannot be reduced to a guarantee that union produces concord. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/hesiod/hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white/SOURCE|Hesiod's source house]] sources the genealogy at 933–937; the two-logics reading remains the essay's own mythemic development.

Hephaestus's bonds gather the lovers by immobilising them. Helios supplies detection; the gods' assembled gaze turns capture into public evidence; bride-gifts and the adulterer's fine convert grievance into account; Hermes exposes the incentive by welcoming the bonds if they bring Aphrodite. The successful apparatus still cannot conclude its business. Poseidon risks his own liability as surety, and Hephaestus accepts the relation his trap cannot manufacture. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/SOURCE|Homer's source house]] sources that detection–capture–account–surety–release sequence. The interpretation as counterfeit gathering and trust is Argued; Homer does not state QL or a theory of surveillance. Cards q004–q008 retain their pending Perseus reread; q001–q003 are quotation-ready.

Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] qualifies the two-logics account with a second, independent distinction: synchronic co-presence and diachronic transformation. Both temporal views can retain relation or lose it. A completed change of perspective and the contextual holding of the perspectives together are likewise different operations. The first-person pressure is preserved in [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/SOURCE|the trust-revision source]], which sources the developmental noncoincidence relation: a self never exhaustively coincides with its own representation, yet its life is constituted through encounters and coincidences. The exact first-person wording attributed there to Frank remains unconfirmed: the later corpus sweep found no independent transcript, and harmonisation-plan D4 explicitly requires wording confirmation before verbatim use. The image becomes an idol when it claims exhaustive coincidence with what it images; determinate identity itself remains necessary.

## #5→0

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn|C50]] defines the reusable pair. A13 derives why neither cutting nor gathering is self-sufficient, then returns the achieved relation to [[A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|A14]], which extends it into consequential transformations of a world. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] extends its criterion into intelligence able to return authority to what it depends upon. The live movement consumers are M19, M20, M21, M22, M24 and M26; downstream A14–A18, A19–A25 and A31–A33 retain their distinct offices.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] tests the technical consequence through q029: a common decision-procedural grammar must preserve divergent world-models. Different premises must remain contestable; agreement is not evidence of a shared field if the method suppresses the difference which would test it. This is the essay's response to the brief, whose scenario modality at q042 remains intact.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Homologia / Analogia]] qualifies these passages as operational homology, evidence register 3. The shared operation is retained differentiation and return; common lexical descent, doctrinal identity and empirical causal sameness require their own evidence. Greek descent of *dia-ballein* and *sym-ballein* and historical claims about particular political formations remain Open.

**Depth Restoration:** restored here: polar/cancelled/appropriated operations; AND/OR obverse and literal two-plus-four count; hidden combining office; two-monoculture recurrence; problem/predicament distinction; whole mythic counter-operation; independent temporal axis and the noncoincidence operation with its exact-wording debt. Provenance: direct historical carrier 03, core IV/XI, trust-revision §7.3, *Symbolon Dynamics*, and Q27 §§5–6/10 as located by the existing A13 recovery packet. Historical/clinical evidence and lexical debts remain separate from the native derivation.
